gloss: food and drink bill; cost of eating out

definitions.gloss: food and drink bill; cost of eating out
definitions.explanation: The amount charged or spent on food and drink, typically at a restaurant, bar, or similar establishment.

examples.japanese: {飲食代|いんしょくだい}を{払|はら}う。
examples.english: To pay the food and drink bill.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{飲食代|いんしょくだい}がかさんだ。
examples.english: My eating-out costs piled up this month.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}のあとの{飲食代|いんしょくだい}は{会社|かいしゃ}が{負担|ふたん}してくれる。
examples.english: The company covers the food and drink costs after meetings.

notes:
Formed from {飲食|いんしょく} (eating and drinking) plus the suffix {代|だい} (charge, fee). Refers to the money spent on meals and drinks rather than to a single itemized check.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲食代|いんしょくだい}を{払|はら}う: to pay the food and drink bill
- {飲食代|いんしょくだい}がかさむ: for eating-out costs to mount up
- {飲食代|いんしょくだい}を{経費|けいひ}で{落|お}とす: to write off dining costs as expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲|の}み{代|だい}: drinking expenses — limited to alcohol and bar tabs
- {食費|しょくひ}: food expenses — everyday cost of groceries and meals, not eating out specifically
